findings.finding: Potential overgeneralisation from generic parasitic treatment to neurological Gnathostoma, and from genital HSV suppression to recurrent meningitis.
findings.resolution: CurrentCDC and original Mahidol/KhonKaen2011 review both retain uncertain CNS anthelmintic/steroid benefits and potential worsening. HSV CNS treatment is distinct, long-term prevention not promised; no skin/genital regimens copied.

dispute_adjudication.resolution: Pathogen, age, post-neurosurgical device, immune status and local resistance guide treatment. Common uncertainty retained for neurognathostomiasis and injection-associated fungi; no old regional doses or generalized adenovirus antiviral regimen.
